shadows.name: toast-float
shadows.purpose: Night theme: the toast, the only floating element.

motion.name: duration-stroke
motion.purpose: Strike line drawn left to right (scaleX 0 to 1); no transition under reduced motion.

motion.name: duration-control
motion.purpose: Button border, background, and colour transitions.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Standard compact action with a strong-rule border.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #8e8e86); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel, #232322); color: var(--ink, #f5f5ee); font: 500 13.5px/1 Barlow, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3, #b4b4a9); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #ffa18d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per view, filled in blue ink.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary" type="button"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 3.2v9.6L12.6 8z"/></svg>Run now</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--blue, #ffa18d); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--blue, #ffa18d); color: var(--ground, #1a1a19); font: 600 13.5px/1 Barlow, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #ffa18d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Borderless until hover; pager arrows and theme toggle.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" type="button" aria-label="Previous week"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 3.5 5.5 8l4.5 4.5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 36px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #d2d2c8); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--ink, #f5f5ee); border-color: var(--rule-strong, #8e8e86); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #ffa18d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Index Tabs
components.description: Uppercase Semi Condensed tabs on the margin-panel strip; the active tab carries a 2px blue-ink rule.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #494945); background: var(--panel-2, #2e2e2b); } .ds-tab { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 14px 11px; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink-2, #d2d2c8); font: 600 13px/1 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--ink, #f5f5ee); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 10px; right: 10px; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; background: var(--blue, #ffa18d); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #ffa18d); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-count { font: 500 11.5px/1 Barlow, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; color: var(--ink-3, #b4b4a9); } .ds-flag { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--warn, #e5a54b); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Outlined option group for filters and classification; the pressed option takes the blue wash.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #8e8e86); border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-seg button { height: 26px; padding: 0 9px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink-2, #d2d2c8); font: 400 12.5px/1 Barlow, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #8e8e86); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--blue-soft, rgba(90, 162, 255, 0.14)); color: var(--blue, #ffa18d); font-weight: 600; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--ink, #f5f5ee); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #ffa18d); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Filter Input
components.description: Compact search field on panel fill with a blue caret.
components.html: <input class="ds-filter" type="search" placeholder="Filter folders" aria-label="Filter folders">
components.css: .ds-filter { height: 30px; width: 220px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #8e8e86); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel, #232322); color: var(--ink, #f5f5ee); font: 400 15px/1.5 Barlow, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; caret-color: var(--blue, #ffa18d); } .ds-filter::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #b4b4a9); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #ffa18d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Log Table
components.description: Ruled log page: label heads over a double rule, 44px rows with vertical hairlines, tabular right-aligned numbers, line-pattern state markers, fixed-scale attention bars, totals under a double rule.
components.html:

Sample projectOngoing427

Totals this page5272 projects
components.css: .ds-log { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: var(--panel, #232322); color: var(--ink, #f5f5ee); font: 400 15px/1.5 Barlow, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-log th { padding: 11px 10px 9px; text-align: right; border-bottom: 3px double var(--rule-strong, #8e8e86); font: 600 11.5px/1.15 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, #b4b4a9); } .ds-log td { padding: 0 10px; height: 44px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #494945); text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-log td + td, .ds-log th + th { border-left: 1px solid var(--rule, #494945); } .ds-log th:nth-child(-n+2), .ds-log td:nth-child(-n+2), .ds-log th:last-child, .ds-log td:last-child { text-align: left; } .ds-log th:first-child, .ds-log td:first-child { padding-left: 18px; } .ds-log tbody tr { cursor: pointer; } .ds-log tbody tr:hover td { background: var(--blue-soft, rgba(90, 162, 255, 0.14)); } .ds-log tfoot td { height: 38px; font-weight: 600; background: var(--panel-2, #2e2e2b); border-top: 3px double var(--rule-strong, #8e8e86); } .ds-log .ds-foot { font: 600 11.5px/1 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #d2d2c8); } .ds-zero { color: var(--ink-3, #b4b4a9); } .ds-state { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink-2, #d2d2c8); font-size: 13.5px; } .ds-state::before { content: ""; width: 18px; border-top: 2px solid currentColor; } .ds-state.ongoing { color: var(--blue, #ffa18d); } .ds-state.exploring::before { border-top-style: dashed; } .ds-att { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-track { position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 80px; height: 8px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--bar-track, #505049); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 calc(10% - 1px), var(--rule, #494945) calc(10% - 1px) 10%); } .ds-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--bar, #d4d4c8); } .ds-att span { width: 3.2ch; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2, #d2d2c8); }

components.name: Ink, Pencil, Struck Entries
components.description: Learned entries carry certainty by writing instrument; striking draws one ruled line left to right and Undo lifts it.
components.html:
• Prefers small reviewable changes.
  • Writes tests before refactors.
  • Works mostly at night.
components.css: .ds-entries { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font: 400 15px/1.5 Barlow, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #f5f5ee); } .ds-entry { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 4px 14px; padding: 11px 0 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #494945); } .ds-text { position: relative; justify-self: start; } .ds-entry.ink .ds-text { text-decoration: underline 1.5px var(--blue, #ffa18d); text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-entry.pencil .ds-text { color: var(--pencil, #b4b4a9); text-decoration: underline 1px dashed var(--pencil, #b4b4a9); text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-text::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -2px; right: -2px; top: 55%; height: 1.5px; background: var(--ink-2, #d2d2c8); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-entry.struck .ds-text { color: var(--ink-3, #b4b4a9); } .ds-entry.struck .ds-text::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-strike, .ds-undo { height: 26px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: none; color: var(--ink-3, #b4b4a9); font: 400 12.5px/1 Barlow, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-strike:hover { color: var(--bad, #ff7a6b); border-color: var(--rule-strong, #8e8e86); } .ds-undo { color: var(--blue, #ffa18d); } .ds-undo:hover { border-color: var(--rule-strong, #8e8e86); } .ds-strike:focus-visible, .ds-undo:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #ffa18d); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-text::after { transition: none; } }

components.name: Eight-Week History
components.description: Eight columns on one axis and one fixed scale; empty weeks show a 2px track stub.
components.css: .ds-weeks { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr); gap: 3px; width: 208px; height: 22px; align-items: end; } .ds-weeks i { display: block; min-height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--bar, #d4d4c8); } .ds-weeks i.none { height: 2px; background: var(--bar-track, #505049); }

narrative.overview: The approved design combines the Reading Room composition with Signal colors. The primary task is reviewing weekly work and what the brain learned. The implementation is plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript inside the Python package; shared components remain in app.css and the selected layout and theme live in reading-room.css.
rules: All columns remain accessible on mobile
Skill levels come from the engine
dos: Use semantic root tokens in both themes
Preserve every existing view and control
Keep browser surfaces in the selected palette
donts: Do not copy private data or screenshots to the public repository
Do not color attention measurements with the action accent
Do not hide new or unranked skill evidence
